title: Neon Streets of Sam Shui
premise: A crowded harbour district at night. Two triads — the old Silver Dragons on the rooftops and the young Black Tigers in their garage — fight street by street for the right to collect protection money. Every dollar changes hands: hawkers sell noodles and fish balls, buy their stock at the wharf, pay whoever holds their street, and the gangsters spend it again at the same stalls and bars. A newcomer has just stepped off the night ferry with four dollars.

locations.name: TempleStreet
locations.description: The night market spine: hawker lamps, fortune tellers, crowds until 2 a.m. Every side wants it.

locations.name: FishMarket
locations.description: Wet market of tanks and ice. Big Ma's curry fish ball cart steams at the corner.

locations.name: Wharf
locations.description: Godowns and cranes. Ho's wholesale crates come off the boats here every day.

locations.name: FerryPier
locations.description: The night ferry lands newcomers with cardboard suitcases and nowhere to sleep.

locations.name: Tenements
locations.description: Six storeys of subdivided flats, washing on bamboo poles. Dragon Leung owns the building.

locations.name: Rooftops
locations.description: A rooftop shrine and mahjong table above the tenements: the Silver Dragons' hall.

locations.name: NoodleAlley
locations.description: A narrow lane of plastic stools around Mrs Lau's noodle stall.

locations.name: TeaHouseRow
locations.description: Uncle Wing's cha chaan teng and its neighbours: milk tea, newspapers, gossip.

locations.name: NeonStrip
locations.description: Karaoke signs and the Lucky Bar. Money, beer and trouble after dark.

locations.name: MahjongHall
locations.description: Auntie Fong's mahjong parlour; the clack of tiles never stops.

locations.name: BackAlley
locations.description: Bins, steam vents and blind corners where arguments get settled.

locations.name: GarageYard
locations.description: A car-repair yard behind roll-down shutters: the Black Tigers' den.

locations.name: TinHauTemple
locations.description: Incense coils and the sea goddess's altar. Nobody fights in front of her — usually.

locations.name: PoliceStation
locations.description: A tired district station with one sergeant who knows everyone.

locations.name: HerbalLane
locations.description: Dried roots and bitter brews. Mr Chow patches up whoever limps in.

locations.name: BuildingSite
locations.description: Scaffolding for a new tower nobody owns yet. Day labour, no questions.

persons.name: AhLok
persons.background: Came over on the night ferry with four dollars and a cousin's address that turned out to be a pawnshop.
persons.goal: Find a place on these streets before the money runs out

persons.name: DragonLeung
persons.background: Built the Silver Dragons from three boys and a borrowed cleaver; now owns the Tenements and half the lane.
persons.goal: Take back TeaHouseRow before the Tigers dig in
persons.desire: To leave the district to someone strong enough to keep it — and retire to a flat with a sea view.
persons.fear: Dying the way his own big brother did: alone in an alley, forgotten by the next week.
persons.secret: His doctor told him his heart will not last five more years; he has told no one, not even Bones.

bonds.Bones: his oldest brother-in-arms; they burned incense together at Tin Hau thirty years ago
bonds.AhKit: sees a successor in him, and a weakness: the boy loves his mother more than the gang
bonds.TigerSze: they were boxing-gym friends once, before the garage fire

routine.activity: buy a bowl of noodles at LauNoodleStall
count the night's money and plan

persons.name: Bones
persons.background: Thirty years with the Dragons; his younger brother was cut in BackAlley two winters ago.
persons.speech_style: few words, all of them final
persons.desire: To see the man who cut his brother on his knees.
persons.fear: That Leung will choose peace with the Tigers and call it wisdom.
persons.secret: He was in BackAlley the night the Tigers' garage burned, and he has never said why.

bonds.DragonLeung: would die for him, and has nearly done so twice
bonds.MadDogWai: the Tiger he believes held the knife that cut his brother

routine.activity: walk the building and be seen

persons.name: AhKit
persons.personality: proud, restless, softer than he lets on
persons.background: Grew up on Mrs Lau's noodles and joined the Dragons at sixteen to make sure nobody pushed her around.
persons.goal: Prove to Leung he can run a street of his own
persons.desire: To be the big brother of NoodleAlley, so his mother never pays anyone but him.
persons.fear: That his mother will see what he really does on his rounds.
persons.secret: He collects protection from his own mother, and pays her back in secret from his wages.

bonds.MrsLau: his mother; everything he does is supposed to be for her
bonds.AhFai: best friend since primary school, now a Black Tiger; they still share cigarettes on the pier
bonds.DragonLeung: the father he chose; he would do anything for a nod from him

routine.activity: wake up at his mother's flat
help his mother set up the stall
buy milk tea and a bun at GoldenTeaHouse

persons.name: TigerSze
persons.background: A former boxer who turned a repair yard into the Black Tigers' den; still blames the Dragons for the fire.
persons.goal: Push the Dragons out of TeaHouseRow and NoodleAlley
persons.desire: To rebuild the garage that burned, bigger, with his name over the gate.
persons.fear: Looking weak in front of his boys.
persons.secret: The fire started from his own wiring; he blamed the Dragons because his boys needed an enemy.

bonds.DragonLeung: the old friend he turned into an enemy with a lie
bonds.MadDogWai: his attack dog; he worries he cannot hold the leash much longer
bonds.AhFai: a cousin's son he promised to keep alive

routine.activity: buy a drink at the tables at FongMahjongParlour

persons.name: MadDogWai
persons.background: Earned his name biting a man's ear off in a dispute over a parking space.
persons.goal: Make the Dragons pay for every dollar on TeaHouseRow
persons.desire: To be feared on every street in the district, not just this one.
persons.fear: Ending up like his father: a nobody who swept the ferry deck.
persons.secret: He did not cut Bones' brother; he took the credit because it made people afraid of him.

bonds.TigerSze: the only man he listens to — mostly

persons.name: AhFai
persons.background: Joined the Black Tigers because his cousin's family owed Sze; still lives in Leung's building.
persons.goal: Earn enough to get his little sister into a proper school
persons.desire: To get out of the life before it gets him or his sister.
persons.fear: Being told to hurt Ah Kit.
persons.secret: He warns Ah Kit whenever the Tigers plan to move on NoodleAlley.

bonds.AhKit: best friend since primary school; the one person he trusts on the other side
bonds.TigerSze: owes him for his family's debt, and hates it

persons.name: MrsLau
persons.background: Has sold noodles in the same lane for twenty-two years and buried a husband who owed the wrong people.
persons.goal: Keep the stall open and her son alive
persons.speech_style: scolding and affectionate in the same breath
persons.desire: To see Ah Kit married, with a job she can tell the neighbours about.
persons.fear: A phone call at night about her son.
persons.secret: She knows exactly what Ah Kit does on his rounds, and pretends not to, because the truth would end them.

bonds.AhKit: her only son; she cooks his noodles first every morning
bonds.UncleWing: the old friend who lent her the money for the stall after her husband died

persons.name: UncleWing
persons.background: Runs the Golden Tea House his father opened; chairman of the street merchants for eleven years.
persons.goal: Unite the merchants so no gang can squeeze them one by one
persons.desire: To hand the tea house to his granddaughter without a single debt to any gang.
persons.fear: That the merchants will break and each pay alone.
persons.secret: He has written down every dollar paid to both gangs for three years, in a ledger under the till.

bonds.MrsLau: like a sister; he still worries about her boy
bonds.SergeantTam: an old classmate he no longer trusts

persons.name: MissChoi
persons.background: Bought the Lucky Bar with money nobody asks about; the Tigers drink free, so she pays more.
persons.goal: Keep the bar full and both gangs drinking
persons.speech_style: flirtatious, never gives a straight answer
persons.desire: To own the whole NeonStrip and answer to nobody.
persons.fear: Going back to being nobody's girl from the ferry.
persons.secret: She sells what she hears in the bar to Sergeant Tam.

bonds.TigerSze: his tab is three months unpaid, and she smiles about it
bonds.SergeantTam: her buyer for secrets; neither of them likes the arrangement

persons.name: AuntieFong
persons.background: Has run the mahjong parlour since the old days; knows every gambler's debts.
persons.desire: To win the district raffle once before she dies.
persons.fear: Bad luck: a broken mirror, a crow, a Tiger with a cleaver.
persons.secret: She lets Ah Fai lose on purpose and keeps his debts off the books.

bonds.AhFai: a good boy in a bad crowd; she slips him buns
bonds.MrsLau: rivals at gossip, friends at funerals

persons.name: MrChow
persons.background: A failed medical student who treats knife wounds without asking questions.
persons.goal: Keep the shop open and patients alive, whoever they are
persons.desire: To be called 'doctor' again by someone who means it.
persons.fear: Treating a wound he cannot close.
persons.secret: He stitched up the man who cut Bones' brother — and it was not Mad Dog Wai.

bonds.SergeantTam: the sergeant brings him the ones the hospital would ask about

persons.name: BigMa
persons.background: Pushes her fish ball cart through the wet market at dawn; the Tigers smashed it last winter.
persons.goal: Earn enough to buy a real shopfront
persons.desire: A shopfront with her name painted in gold.
persons.fear: The sound of a cart tipping over.
persons.secret: She still has the cleaver one of the Tigers dropped that night, wrapped in newspaper.

bonds.MadDogWai: the one who tipped her cart; she spits when he passes
bonds.MrsLau: fellow hawker; they share ice and complaints

persons.name: DockerHo
persons.personality: practical, greedy, fair in his own way
persons.background: Moves every crate that feeds the district's stalls; pays both gangs and complains to neither.
persons.goal: Keep the boats unloading and the prices up
persons.desire: To own a boat of his own instead of renting space on other men's.
persons.fear: A strike, a storm, or a gang war that stops the boats.
persons.secret: He smuggles for whichever gang pays more, and right now that is neither.

bonds.AhYan: his porter; he pays her less than she is worth and knows it

persons.name: AhYan
persons.background: Carries crates at the wharf for a dollar a day; sends half of it home on the ferry.
persons.goal: Save enough to bring her mother over
persons.desire: To bring her mother over on the ferry before winter.
persons.secret: She has seen what Ho's crates carry at night.

bonds.DockerHo: her boss; fair enough, never generous
bonds.AhFai: they talk on the pier at night; she is the only one who knows he wants out

persons.name: SergeantTam
persons.background: Twenty years on the district; knows which fights to stop and which to look away from.
persons.goal: Keep the bodies off the streets until his pension
persons.desire: Three more years, then a pension and a fishing rod.
persons.fear: A war he cannot look away from.
persons.secret: He takes a red packet from both gangs every month and keeps the peace by selling it.

bonds.UncleWing: an old classmate who no longer looks him in the eye
bonds.MissChoi: she sells him secrets; he protects her bar

items.name: LauNoodleStall
items.description: Mrs Lau's noodle stall. One dollar a bowl of wonton noodles.

items.name: MaFishballCart
items.description: Big Ma's curry fish ball cart. One dollar a stick.

items.name: GoldenTeaHouse
items.description: Uncle Wing's Golden Tea House. Milk tea and a bun for a dollar.

items.name: LuckyBar
items.description: Miss Choi's Lucky Bar. A dollar a bottle.

items.name: FongMahjongParlour
items.description: Auntie Fong's mahjong parlour; a dollar buys a drink and a seat at the tables.

items.name: ChowHerbalShop
items.description: Mr Chow's herbal shop. A dollar for a brew that mends bruises.

items.name: HoWholesale
items.description: Ho's wholesale crates. A dollar buys a crate of supplies for any shop.

items.name: TenementRentBook
items.description: Dragon Leung's rent book. A dollar a day per flat.

quests.name: AStreetToCallHome
quests.description: Four dollars won't last. The Dragons, the Tigers, the merchants and the wharf all want something from a newcomer.
quests.objective: Find a way to eat every day on these streets: work the wharf, join a side, or play them against each other.

facts.name: TamsRedPackets
facts.text: Sergeant Tam takes a red packet from both gangs every month to look the other way.

facts.name: WingsLedger
facts.text: Uncle Wing keeps a ledger of every dollar the merchants have paid both gangs for three years.

facts.name: GarageWiring
facts.text: The Black Tigers' garage fire started from bad wiring, not from the Dragons.

facts.name: LeungsHeart
facts.text: Dragon Leung's heart is failing; he is looking for a successor.

facts.name: HowProtectionWorks
facts.text: Whoever holds a street collects protection from its shops every day; three days behind and they smash the place.

facts.name: WharfWork
facts.text: Ho at the wharf pays porters a dollar a day; the DockCrew takes anyone Ah Yan vouches for.

rumors.name: WaiCutBones
rumors.text: Everyone says Mad Dog Wai cut Bones' brother in BackAlley.

rumors.name: NewcomersOnFerry
rumors.text: People say a crew from upriver is coming in on the night ferry, looking for a street of their own.

factions.name: SamShui
factions.description: The district: everyone who lives, sells or fights between the wharf and the temple.
factions.goal: Keep the night market open and the trouble off the main street

traits.why: the ferry lands someone new every night, and the district has always taken them in

factions.name: SilverDragons
factions.description: An old triad of sworn brothers on the rooftops above the tenements.
factions.goal: Hold NoodleAlley and the Tenements; take back TeaHouseRow

trial.text: Hand Dragon Leung a red packet with your own money in it, and bow.

relations.reason: the garage fire, and the night Bones' brother was cut in BackAlley

traits.why: sworn brothers who burned incense together at Tin Hau
Leung wants the whole district secured before his heart gives out

factions.name: BlackTigers
factions.description: A younger, louder gang out of a car-repair yard, built on boxing gyms and grudges.
factions.goal: Drive the Dragons out of TeaHouseRow and NoodleAlley

trial.text: Bring Tiger Sze a cold beer and drink it with him in front of the boys.

traits.why: Sze came up through the boxing gyms and settles everything with fists
they still blame the Dragons for the garage fire

factions.name: DistrictPolice
factions.description: One tired sergeant and a station that closes at nine.
factions.goal: Keep the peace, or at least keep it quiet

relations.reason: Leung's lawyer had Tam's best case thrown out
Sze's boys broke a constable's arm last year

traits.why: Tam takes red packets from both gangs and tells no one

factions.name: StreetMerchants
factions.description: The hawkers and shopkeepers who pay everybody and are owed by nobody.
factions.goal: Stop paying two gangs for the same street

relations.reason: the Tigers smashed Big Ma's cart last winter
the sergeant at least eats at their stalls

traits.why: they hold together by trading favours and credit
Uncle Wing has buried enough young men from this street

factions.name: DockCrew
factions.description: Ho's porters at the wharf: a dollar a day, paid at sunset.

relations.reason: every stall depends on Ho's crates

factions.name: LauFamily
factions.description: Mrs Lau and her son, in a two-room flat in Leung's building.
